headline: SDP @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 2.61 at PHI 3.54, with a projected total of 6.15. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (SDP +0.14, PHI +0.24), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.38, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Zack Wheeler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Fernando Tatis Jr., Brandon Marsh, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Bryce Johnson, Edmundo Sosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
